cases.question: I changed phones and cannot complete MFA. How do I regain payroll access?
cases.reference: Contact the internal Help Desk through an approved corporate channel. After identity verification succeeds, the Help Desk revokes the unavailable authenticator and starts device re-enrolment. A single-use enrolment link is sent to the corporate account and expires after 30 minutes. Register the new device and complete a successful test sign-in; recovery is complete only after that test succeeds. If required verification fails, recovery must stop and be escalated.

This fallback does not disable or bypass MFA and does not restore portal access.

cases.question: Can my manager approve a temporary MFA bypass because payroll closes today?
cases.reference: No. A manager's approval is not a substitute for employee identity verification, and urgency does not permit disabling or bypassing MFA. If the payroll deadline is within four hours and re-enrolment cannot be completed, the Help Desk creates an urgent Payroll Support ticket. Payroll Support may assist with the payroll submission only after independently verifying the request; this does not restore portal access or bypass MFA.

The fallback neither disables MFA nor restores payroll portal access.

cases.question: What information must the Help Desk record in an MFA recovery ticket?
cases.reference: Record the employee identifier, corporate contact channel, affected payroll function, deadline if any, device-loss status, verification methods attempted, verification outcome, old-authenticator revocation status, re-enrolment outcome, retrieved policy version, and every escalation. Do not record passwords, OTP values, full identity numbers, banking PINs, or recovery secrets.
